adversarial_test_results.detail: Same token ' at' stranded finally with no complement, so it cannot open a PP; tests stranded use versus PP onset.
Same token ' in' stranded finally with no complement, so it cannot open a PP or link a clause; tests stranded mention versus onset.
'on' as a cited switch label with no object NP after it, so it cannot open a PP; tests label use versus prepositional onset.
'by' as a final adverb with no object in a verbless fragment, so it cannot open a PP; tests adverbial versus prepositional use.
'is' and 'are' cited as spelling forms with no predicate complement after final 'are'; tests mention versus predicative use.
'then' stranded finally with no following clause, so it cannot link clauses; tests final adverb versus clause-linker use.
'stared' buried as an attributive modifier inside a verbless NP instead of opening a VP; tests NP-internal versus VP-initial position.
Same letters as ORDER but lowercase/reordered so the uppercase SQL-clause token is absent and nothing opens a code clause.
Code topic as a verbless NP with no zeros/ORDER/O subword onset; tests same topic without the claimed code onset feature.
Document topic with no tags or h onset; tests same markup topic without the claimed markup-item onset.
Time topic expressed with bare NPs and no at/in/on/by/of preposition; tests same time-adjunct topic without prepositional onset.
